name: Women Leaders of Tomorrow (WLOT)
description:
The Women Leaders of Tomorrow (WLOT) High School Scholarship Program offers Afghan female students the opportunity to pursue high school education in Canada in 2026. Designed for academically strong and highly motivated girls aged 16–17, the program supports students with excellent academic records, strong English proficiency, and clear leadership potential. Selected students gain access to international education, personal development, and long-term leadership growth opportunities. Applications must be submitted by email only, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps.
 Deadline: January 31, 2026 |
Contact Email: info@womenleaders.ca |
Website: www.womenleaders.ca
